def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, BitVec, BitVecVal, Solver, And, sat

    # --- Variables from base script ---
    connected = Int('connected')
    md = Int('md')
    use_cache = Int('use_cache')
    tun_info = Int('tun_info')

    # --- Variables from constraint set 2 ---
    tun_info_bv = BitVec('tun_info_bv', 64)
    tun_info_mode = BitVec('tun_info_mode', 32)
    tun_info_af = BitVec('tun_info_af', 16)
    tun_info_key_u_ipv4_dst = BitVec('tun_info_key_u_ipv4_dst', 32)
    payload_protocol = BitVec('payload_protocol', 16)

    IP_TUNNEL_INFO_TX = BitVecVal(0x1, 32)
    AF_INET = BitVecVal(2, 16)

    def htons(x):
        return ((x & 0xFF) << 8) | ((x >> 8) & 0xFF)

    ETH_P_IP_HTONS = BitVecVal(htons(0x0800), 16)
    ETH_P_IPV6_HTONS = BitVecVal(htons(0x86DD), 16)

    s = Solver()

    # --- Base script constraints ---
    s.add(And(connected == 1, md == 1))
    s.add(use_cache == 1)
    s.add(tun_info == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 1 constraints ---
    s.add(tun_info == 0)
    s.add(use_cache == 0)
    s.add(md == 0)
    s.add(connected == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 2 constraints ---
    s.add(tun_info_bv != 0)
    s.add((tun_info_mode & IP_TUNNEL_INFO_TX) != 0)
    s.add(tun_info_af == AF_INET)
    s.add(tun_info_key_u_ipv4_dst != 0)
    s.add(payload_protocol != ETH_P_IP_HTONS)
    s.add(payload_protocol != ETH_P_IPV6_HTONS)

    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
